Bukit Timah

Bukit Timah 3

  1. Must see · Bukit Timah

    Singapore Botanic Gardens

    Singapore's first UNESCO World Heritage Site (2015); a 160-year-old tropical garden with the National Orchid Garden.

    Look for Garden

    1 Cluny Road, Bukit Timah

    Recommended by UNESCO World Heritage, NParks (National Parks Board)

  2. Must see · Malay & Nasi Padang · Bukit Timah

    Selera Rasa Nasi Lemak

    Michelin Bib Gourmand nasi lemak on basmati; reportedly a favourite of the Sultan of Brunei.

    #01-15 Adam Road Food Centre, 2 Adam Road, Bukit Timah

    Recommended by MICHELIN Guide, Daniel Food Diary

  3. Worth the detour · Bukit Timah

    Bukit Timah Nature Reserve

    ASEAN Heritage Park protecting primary rainforest and Singapore's highest natural point (163 m).

    Look for Nature

    177 Hindhede Drive, Bukit Timah

    Recommended by NParks (National Parks Board), Wikipedia (English)
